Article 2.2: Express OG Accounts (Full Specifications)

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule

OG accounts are no longer sold. Existing OG accounts keep their rules. Once an Express OG account is blown, it cannot be reset. Traders looking for a new account should consider Standard MAX or STEADY.

What Is an Express OG Account?

Express OG accounts follow the same path as Standard OG (evaluation → exhibition → funded) but require only 4 minimum trading days and have a 25% consistency rule during evaluation. Express OG is designed for traders who want to reach funding faster while still building an exhibition buffer.

CONSISTENCY RULE CONFIRMED: Express OG evaluation consistency is 25%. The minimum trading days is 4 (not 7 like Standard OG). The fastest possible pass time with Express OG is 4 days.
Evaluation Rules: Express OG
Drawdown Type: Realized Trailing (updates after each trade closes)
Daily Loss Limit: None
Minimum Trading Days: 4 days (at least 1 trade per day to count)
Consistency Rule: 25% of total profit target in any single session
News Trading: Permitted in evaluation. Restricted in Exhibition and Funded (see Article 3.3)
Activation Fee (to Exhibition): $120 (may be waived during promotions)
Evaluation Reset Fee: $100

Funded Account Rules: Express OG (Sim-Funded)
Drawdown Type: Static +$100 after buffer is built
Consistency Rule: 40%
Payout Frequency: Same-day
Exhibition Stage: YES, buffer built in exhibition before funding (same as Standard OG)
